title: The Radiators of the family house on Kessler Street
author: Noor Villalobos
blurb: Sebastian Pemberton, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
